name: input
title: Input
summary: Standard single-line text input. v0.6 adopts the field-shell visual contract — standalone, this input paints its own border, bg, and focus halo. Inside <Field>, the wrapper paints; the input renders bare via .lumen-field globals (no double ring). Body type is text-body-md (14px).
description: Token-driven single-line text input with the v0.6 field-shell visual contract.
skillDescription: Use when generating a standard text input in a Lumen-themed React app. Returns a token-driven input with hairline border, lime focus halo, error variant via aria-invalid, and the field-shell visual contract. Composes inside <Field> without double-rings.
useWhen: Any single-line text entry — email, name, lane code, weight, search query.
Inside <Field> (the v0.6 form shell) — pair with <Label> and optional <ValidationMessage>.
Standalone — for inline filter chips or quick-search boxes.
api: `type` — text | email | password | search | tel | url | number (use NumberInput for numerics with steppers).
never: NEVER hardcode color / spacing / radius. Tokens only.
NEVER use type=password — install PasswordInput (it has the reveal toggle + caps-lock affordance).
NEVER nest <Input> directly inside another input.
a11yRules: Pair with <Label htmlFor> in <Field>, or supply aria-label / aria-labelledby standalone.
Use aria-describedby when paired with a ValidationMessage.
aria-invalid triggers the error halo + ring; pair with descriptive ValidationMessage.
do: Use semantic type=email / type=tel for mobile keyboard hints.
dont: Don't use as a multi-line input — use <Textarea>.
Don't put a button inside an <Input>; wrap both in a <Field> shell.
